race.comment: Big field but MIDNIGHT RABBLE (4) looks a top chance. Winner three back and placed in tougher grade in two runs since. All wins have been this trip and looks a top chance to find winning form again. ADVISER (2) progressed nicely last time out to finish just half a length from the winner in third over 1000m at Gunnedah. The engagement of Gabrielle Johnston is noteworthy. Will be winding up strongly. METEOR MIST (6) was too good for a maiden field when very heavily bet last start over 900m at Coonabarabran, scoring by 2.5 lengths. Sparingly raced and has more to offer. Re-unites with Jake Pracey-Holmes who was on board last start. One of the likely contenders despite the step up in grade. KILLIMICAT (11) is fresh from a spell of six months and did hit the frame when last resuming at Wodonga over 1100m. In a different yard now. Resuming in easier and sure to be prominent. OUR EMILY (5) next best.
